content.value: A double acting cylinder is hooked up in a regenerative circuit. The relief valve setting is 105 bar. The piston area is 130 cm² and the rod area is 65 cm². If the pump flow is 0.0016 m³/s, find the cylinder speed and load carrying capacity for both the extending and retracting stroke.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2022
